anna-devex: Heads-up: hitting a parity issue between REST and the JS SDK on embeddings batch. curl to /v1/embeddings?allow_partial=true works, SDK call with { allowPartial: true } returns 400.

mike-sdks: which SDK version and repro?

anna-devex: v1.8.1. Repro: curl above returns 200 with partial vectors for some inputs. JS: 
```js
client.embeddings.create({ model: 'tiny-embed', inputs: ['a','b','c'], allowPartial: true })
```
SDK error: "unknown parameter: allowPartial".

jess-samples: our quickstart CI breaks on mixed batches when this happens, blocks onboarding.

rachel-api: server expects allow_partial in query; we accept both snake and camel in query parsing, but SDK normalizes body keys and validates them strictly. allowPartial is dropped/flagged.

mike-sdks: ok. I'll update param normalization to accept camelCase aliases and emit allow_partial in query for batch endpoints. Also add a test comparing curl vs SDK for shape/status.

anna-devex: one more: REST returns Retry-After on 429, SDK currently only honors x-retry-after-ms. Causing rapid retries in staging.

mike-sdks: will change retry middleware to prefer Retry-After header, fallback to x-retry-after-ms, and add deterministic backoff tests.

sam-platform: adding that fix will stop CI flakiness for sample apps.

deploy-bot: Branch opened: fix/sdk-allowpartial-retryheaders (#2864) by mike-sdks  CI started.

jess-samples: please add a short CHANGELOG note so users know about camelCase acceptance in v1.8.2.

mike-sdks: will do. Also adding a tiny samples/ci smoke test to diff curl vs SDK response shapes for embeddings/generate.

rachel-api: we'll emit both headers for one release window to ease rollouts.

anna-devex: thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands:
